scripts.go_mod: rimraf src/autocomplete/go.sum && cd src/autocomplete && go mod tidy
scripts.prepare_install: npm run clean_dist && npm run clean_embed && npm run build && npm run copy_dist_to_embed
scripts.install_app: npm run prepare_install && npm run go_install
scripts.build_windows_amd64: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 node src/tools/build_go.mjs windows_amd64 gkill_autocomplete.exe
scripts.build_linux_amd64: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 node src/tools/build_go.mjs linux_amd64 gkill_autocomplete
scripts.build_linux_arm64: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 node src/tools/build_go.mjs linux_arm64 gkill_autocomplete
scripts.release: npm run clean_release && npm run prepare_install && npm run build_go_parallel
scripts.test: npm run verify_docs && npm run test_go && npm run test_client
